inputs.prompt: Keep everything in image 1 exactly as it is: the same sunlit room, the same camera position and framing, the same warm light, and the same man sitting up in bed holding his phone, who has not moved. Add one new element: a small owl made of soft mint light (#b7f4cf), about 20 centimetres tall, round and fluffy, its feathers drawn in fine threads of mint light, with a soft white face disc and big, calm, dark eyes with tiny mint highlights. It is a premium, almost photographic creature of light: not a cartoon, not bright green, with no orange beak or feet. It glides through the warm morning light toward the man in bed, wings spread, and is just flying into the screen of the phone in his hands, leaving a short trail of glowing mint particles behind it; the phone's screen glows mint where it enters. The man watches it with a small, rested smile. It must read as friendly, advanced technology, never as a ghost or a spirit: no mist, no smoke, no dark shadows, nothing spooky. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: WP1 and WP3 paid 6 to 9 cents for a 2K picture on this model (demo-video/ledger/wp3.csv)

note: Concept C (a night owl of light, from the phone), still 3: in the morning it flies back into the phone in his hand
